author: Priyanka Patel
title: Meghan Markle's Netflix Show Misses Top 10: Does Netflix Care?
text:
LOS ANGELES – Meghan markle’s lifestyle show, With Love ,Meghan ,returned for its second season on August 26,debuting eight new episodes but failing to crack Netflix’s top 10 most-watched shows for the month.
Meghan Markle’s ‘With Love, Meghan’ Season 2 Sees Lower Viewership Though the second season garnered less negative attention, it also drew fewer viewers than its predecessor.
Estimates suggest the series likely attracted fewer than 2.1 million viewers in its first week, a dip from the approximately 2.6 million viewers who tuned in for season one’s March premiere, which did land on the top 10 list.
This viewership trend may not be ideal for Meghan, her husband Prince Harry, and their production company, Archewell. However, the situation isn’t a complete setback. Netflix confirmed in early August that it will continue its partnership with Archewell, shifting to a first-look agreement instead of an exclusive overall deal.
Future Projects and the Archewell Deal While a third season of With Love, Meghan has not been officially announced, a holiday special, With Love, Meghan: Holiday Party , is slated for december. Archewell also has other projects in development, including the documentary short Masaka Kids, A Rhythm Within and the romance film Meet Me at the Lake , based on Carley Fortune’s 2023 novel.
The streaming service also maintains an investment in As Ever, the lifestyle brand Meghan Markle launched alongside her Netflix show this spring, which has continued to release new products seasonally.
Netflix has not disclosed financial details of its initial agreement with the Sussexes. In January 2025, a spokesperson refuted the widely reported $100 million figure, stating it was inaccurate. A July report indicated that a new first-look deal might mean less upfront payment for the couple.
this shift mirrors trends for other high-profile Netflix talent. Michelle and Barack Obama, through their Higher Ground Productions, also moved from overall deals to less lucrative first-look agreements.
Did you know? Meghan Markle launched her lifestyle company, As Ever, alongside her Netflix show this spring, which has continued to release new products seasonally.
Media Reception and Future Outlook should With Love, Meghan return, it is likely to continue generating commentary, including critical remarks from the British press. Sandi toksvig, a former host of The Great British Bake-Off , recently quipped on Good Morning Britain that the show “looks like a great tribute to beige.”
What is the viewership for Meghan Markle’s ‘With Love, Meghan’ season two?
Estimates suggest Meghan markle’s ‘With Love, meghan’ season two likely garnered fewer than 2.1 million viewers in its first week, a decrease from season one’s debut viewership.
Meghan Markle’s lifestyle show, with Love, Meghan , saw lower viewership in its second season compared to the first. Season two did not rank among Netflix’s top 10 shows for August. Netflix and archewell, the production company of Meghan and Prince Harry, have shifted to a first-look agreement. Several other archewell productions are in active development, and the lifestyle company As Ever continues to release new products. Other high-profile Netflix talent have also seen their deals transition from overall agreements to first-look deals.
